comments.headline: Site Data Table missing required fields and comparisons
comments.summary: The SDT is incomplete, omitting multiple required development standards fields and failing to show both proposed and maximum allowed values side-by-side for compliance comparison as required by LDC § 25-2-492.

details.text: Floor-to-Area Ratio (FAR) completely missing from SDT. Both proposed FAR and maximum allowed FAR (0.75:1 for MF-2) must be documented for compliance comparison. Calculated value (GFA 83,986 sf ÷ site area 94,192 sf = 0.89:1) cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Floor-to-area ratio (FAR) not shown in SDT expressed as a ratio. The SDT contains GFA (83,986 sq ft) and site area (94,192 sq ft) but does not calculate or display FAR as a ratio (e.g., 0.89:1). Per LDC § 25-1-21(43), FAR must be explicitly shown as a ratio in the SDT.

Floor-to-area ratio (FAR) is completely missing from the Site Data Table. Although total GFA (83,986 sf) and site area (94,192 sf) are shown, no FAR value or ratio is provided. FAR should be expressed as a ratio (e.g., 0.89:1).
Floor-to-area ratio (FAR) is not shown in the Site Data Table. The SDT must display FAR expressed as a ratio (e.g., 0.55:1) for the proposed development.

details.text: Both proposed and maximum allowed FAR not shown in SDT. Per LDC § 25-2-492, SDT must display proposed FAR and maximum allowed FAR for MF-2 zoning district (0.75:1) side-by-side for direct compliance verification.

runComments.comment: Both proposed and maximum allowed FAR not shown in SDT. The SDT omits FAR entirely. Per LDC § 25-2-492, the SDT must display both proposed FAR and the maximum allowed FAR for the MF-2 zoning district (0.75:1 per § 25-2-492) for direct compliance comparison.

Neither proposed FAR nor maximum allowed FAR per LDC § 25-2-492 is shown in the SDT. FAR is absent from all site plan tables and must be added with comparison to the maximum allowable FAR for the MF-2 district.
Both proposed FAR and maximum allowed FAR are not shown in the Site Data Table. For MF-2 zoning, the maximum FAR per LDC § 25-2-492 is 1:1; the SDT must show this maximum alongside the proposed FAR.

details.text: FAR value cannot be reconciled because FAR is not shown in SDT. Addition of FAR to SDT is required to enable reconciliation between stated FAR and calculation of GFA ÷ site area.

runComments.comment: FAR value in SDT does not reconcile with GFA divided by site area because FAR is not shown at all in the SDT. Without FAR displayed, reconciliation cannot occur. Calculate and show FAR in SDT: 83,986 sq ft ÷ 94,192 sq ft = 0.89:1, and compare against maximum allowed FAR of 0.75:1 for MF-2.
FAR value cannot be verified because FAR is not shown in the SDT. Therefore, reconciliation between the stated FAR and the calculation of GFA divided by site area cannot be confirmed.

details.text: Building Height not documented in SDT; must appear in both stories and feet format with comparison of proposed (36'-1" / 3 stories) to maximum allowed (40' per MF-2 zoning).

runComments.comment: Building height not shown in both stories and feet in SDT. The SDT contains no building height field. While Block 14 separately shows individual building heights in feet (e.g., 36'-1") and the project description notes 'Maximum Building Height: 40 ft allowed; 36' - 1" highest proposed,' the main SDT table itself omits height data. Per LDC § 25-2-492, building height must be shown in the SDT in both stories and feet format.

Building height is not shown in the Site Data Table. While a separate Building Height Table shows stories (max 3) and heights in feet (33'-4.75" to 36'-1"), this information is located in an adjacent table, not within the SDT as required.

Building height is not shown in the Site Data Table in both stories and feet. Although a separate Building Height Table (Block 14) exists on Sheet 9, the maximum building height must be documented in the SDT; the heights range from 33'-4.75" to 36'-1", all under the 40' limit.

details.text: Both proposed and maximum allowed building height not shown in SDT for side-by-side compliance comparison. Height data missing from main SDT table. Per LDC § 25-2-492, add fields showing highest proposed building height (36'-1" / 3 stories) and maximum allowed (40') in SDT.

runComments.comment: Both proposed building height and maximum allowed building height not shown in SDT. Building height data is absent from the main SDT table. While Block 14 shows individual building heights and the guide mentions '40 ft allowed,' this comparison must appear in the SDT itself. Per LDC § 25-2-492, add fields showing the highest proposed building height (36'-1" / 3 stories) and the maximum allowed (40' / per code) side-by-side in the SDT.

Both proposed and maximum allowed building height are not shown in the Site Data Table. Building height information appears in an adjacent Building Height Table (showing individual building heights and 40' maximum), not consolidated in the SDT itself.

Both proposed building height and maximum allowed building height are not shown in the Site Data Table. The SDT must include the maximum allowed height (40' for MF-2) and the proposed maximum height (36'-1") for compliance comparison.

details.text: Gross Floor Area per building not shown in SDT. Individual building GFA values (8,550 to 13,004 sf) appear only in separate Block 15 Building Data Table. Per LDC § 25-1-21(47), GFA documentation for each building must appear in SDT.

runComments.comment: Gross floor area not shown for each individual building separately in SDT. The SDT shows only total GFA (83,986 sq ft) while individual building GFA values (ranging from 8,550 to 13,004 sq ft) are relegated to a separate Block 15 table. LDC § 25-1-21(47) requires GFA documentation for each building separately in the SDT for easy verification of compliance.
Individual building GFA values are not shown in the Site Data Table. Building-by-building GFA is documented in an adjacent Building Data Table (Block 15), not within the SDT itself as required.

Gross floor area is not shown for each individual building separately in the Site Data Table. Although a separate Building Data Table (Block 15) shows GFA by building (ranging from 8,550 sf to 13,004 sf), these individual values must be included in the SDT for compliance documentation.

details.text: Finished Floor Elevation (FFE) per building not documented in SDT. FFE values (680.50' to 687.50') are labeled on grading plan (Sheet 11) only. Per FPCM Appendix E, § 1.1.0(K)(4), FFE must be documented per building in SDT in feet above sea level.

runComments.comment: Finished floor elevation (FFE) not documented in SDT. While FFE values are labeled on each building in the site plan drawing (e.g., 'FFE= 687.50'), they do not appear in the main SDT table (Block 16). Per FPCM Appendix E, § 1.1.0(K)(4), FFE must be documented per building in the SDT in feet above sea level. Add a per-building FFE field to the SDT showing each of the eight buildings' finished floor elevations.

Finished floor elevation (FFE) per building is not documented in the Site Data Table. FFE values (ranging from 680.50 to 687.50) are labeled on the Grading Plan for each building but do not appear in the SDT as required.

Finished floor elevation (FFE) is not documented per building in the Site Data Table. Although FFE values are labeled on the grading plan drawing (Sheet 11), they must appear in the SDT in feet above sea level per FPCM requirements: Building 1 (687.50'), Building 2-4 and 8 (685.50'), Building 5-6 (683.00'), Building 7 (685.00').

details.text: Maximum elevation permitted by zoning not shown alongside proposed FFE in SDT. Compliance verification requires comparison of each building's proposed FFE against maximum allowable elevation based on 40-ft height limit.

runComments.comment: Maximum elevation permitted by zoning not shown alongside proposed FFE in SDT. The SDT does not include a field showing either FFE or the maximum permitted elevation based on zoning height limits. While FFE is labeled on the site plan drawing, the SDT table must show both proposed FFE per building and the maximum elevation permitted by zoning for compliance verification. Add fields showing each building's proposed FFE and maximum allowable FFE (based on 40-ft height limit and average grade elevation) side-by-side in the SDT.

Maximum elevation permitted by zoning is not shown in the SDT or compared alongside the proposed FFE for each building. A comparison table must be provided to demonstrate compliance of proposed FFE against the zoning height district maximums.

Maximum elevation permitted by zoning is not shown alongside proposed FFE in the Site Data Table. Since FFE is not in the SDT, this compliance comparison cannot be made. The SDT must show both proposed FFE and the maximum permissible elevation based on the zoning height limit and grade baseline.

details.text: Minimum Site Area Required not shown in SDT. Requirement of 93,600 sf (for 39 two-bedroom units at 2,400 sf/unit per MF-2) appears only in separate Block 17 table. Per LDC § 25-2-492, SDT must show both required (93,600 sf) and provided (94,192 sf) side-by-side.

runComments.comment: Minimum site area required per MF-2 zoning not shown in SDT. The required site area (93,600 sq ft for 39 two-bedroom units) is shown in a separate Block 17 table, but the SDT itself (Block 16) does not include a 'Minimum Site Area Required' field for direct comparison with proposed area. Per LDC § 25-2-492, the SDT must show both the required and provided site area side-by-side.

Minimum site area required per MF-2 zoning is not shown in the Site Data Table. The requirement of 93,600 sf (for 39 units × 2,400 sf/unit) appears only in a separate 'Site Area Calculation (MF-2)' table, not in the main SDT.

Minimum site area required per MF-2 zoning is not shown in the Site Data Table. Although a separate Site Area Calculation table (Block 17) shows the requirement of 93,600 sf for 39 2+ bedroom units, this required value must appear in the SDT for direct comparison with the provided site area of 94,192 sf.

details.text: Land Area Calculation (LOC) number not included in SDT. LOC of 2.26 acres shown on cover sheet but not referenced in or associated with SDT. LOC field must be added to confirm whether LOC is under/over 5 acres and verify impervious cover recalculation (ICR) applicability.

runComments.comment: SDT does not include Land Area Calculation (LOC) number or confirm ICR applicability. Cover sheet (Sheet 1) shows LOC of 2.26 acres separate from site area of 2.16 acres, but LOC is not referenced in the SDT itself. A separate LOC field must be added to the SDT to indicate whether the LOC is under or over 5 acres and confirm impervious cover recalculation requirement (ICR) applicability per DSD standards.

Land Area Calculation (LOC) number is not included in or associated with the Site Data Table. The table shows a separate 'Site Area Calculation (MF-2)' for unit-count requirements but no LOC identifier.

LOC (Land Area Calculation) number is not included in the Site Data Table. The site plan shows Limits of Construction of 2.26 acres on the cover sheet (Sheet 1), but this value and the corresponding LOC number must appear in the SDT to confirm ICR applicability.

details.text: Open Space not shown in percentage format in SDT. Open space shown in square feet (required 4,709.62 / provided 4,710) but percentage (~5% of site area) omitted. Per LDC § 25-2-492, both metric and percentage must be displayed for comparison.

runComments.comment: Open space not shown in SDT in both square feet and percentage. The SDT shows 'Common Open Space Required: 4709.62 sq ft' and 'Common Open Space Provided: 4710 sq ft' but omits the percentage for each (approximately 5% of site area). Per LDC § 25-2-492, both metric and percentage must be shown for direct comparison with zoning requirements.
Open space is shown in square feet (required 4,709.62 sf / provided 4,710 sf) but the percentage is not shown. The requirement specifies both square feet and percentage must be displayed in the SDT.

Open space is not shown in the Site Data Table in both square feet and percentage. The SDT lists Common Open Space Required as 4709.62 sf and Provided as 4710 sf, but the percentage of site area is not shown.

details.text: Foundation Type per Building not documented individually in SDT. Documented as project-wide single value (Slab on Grade) rather than per building. Per Reviewer Convention, must specify for each individual building or explicitly state all share same foundation system.

runComments.comment: Foundation type not documented per building in SDT. The SDT shows 'Building Slab Construction: Slab On Grade' as a general field (not broken down by building), and Block 15 also lists foundation type as a general note. Per Reviewer Convention, the SDT must include foundation type for each individual building in a per-building breakdown format, similar to the Building Data Table, even if all buildings share the same foundation system.

Foundation type is documented as a single project-wide value (Slab on Grade) rather than documented per individual building. If all buildings share the same foundation type, this should be explicitly stated per building or documented separately for each.

details.text: Vehicular Access Point Widths not shown in SDT. Type II driveway width (22.5') and Type III driveway width (26.0') are depicted on site plan drawing but missing from table documentation. Per Reviewer Convention, widths must be included in SDT.

runComments.comment: Widths of vehicular access points are not shown in the Site Data Table. Although access point widths are depicted on the site plan drawing (22.5' for Type II driveway and 26.0' for Type III driveway), these dimensions must be included in the SDT for comprehensive site data documentation.

details.text: Limits of Construction Area table not provided on site plan sheet. Cover sheet indicates 2.26 acres (differs from SDT site area 2.162 acres). Per Reviewer Convention, separate calculation table showing total area within limits of construction must appear on site plan sheet for clarity.

runComments.comment: No separate table is provided on the site plan sheet showing the total area within the limits of construction. The cover sheet indicates 2.26 acres for limits of construction but no detailed calculation table is presented on the site plan sheet.

The Limits of Construction (2.26 acres, shown on cover sheet) differs from the Site Area on the SDT (2.162 acres). A separate table showing the total area within the limits of construction must be provided on the overall site plan sheet for clarity on which area applies to which calculations.

details.text: SDT fails to show both proposed and maximum allowed values side-by-side for all applicable development standards. Multiple fields missing from SDT or shown only in separate adjacent tables (Blocks 14, 15, 17), preventing unified compliance verification.

runComments.comment: SDT not showing both proposed and maximum allowed values for all applicable fields. The SDT is incomplete with missing comparisons for: (1) Floor-to-Area Ratio (FAR) — not shown at all; (2) Building Height — not shown in SDT (shown separately in Block 14); (3) Finished Floor Elevation — not shown in SDT; (4) Gross Floor Area per building — not shown per building in SDT (shown separately in Block 15); (5) Minimum site area required — not shown in SDT (shown separately in Block 17); (6) Open space percentage — not shown. Per LDC § 25-2-492, all comparison fields must appear in the SDT for direct compliance verification.

The SDT does not show both proposed and maximum allowed values for all applicable fields. Specifically, FAR (both proposed and maximum) and building height (both proposed and maximum) are missing from the SDT, appearing only in adjacent separate tables.

The Site Data Table does not show both proposed and maximum allowed values for all applicable fields. Missing comparisons include: FAR (not shown at all), building height (not in SDT), FFE (not in SDT), and Gross Floor Area maximum (not applicable to show max). The SDT must document all development standards with their allowed and proposed values in side-by-side comparison format.

comments.headline: GFA definition and calculation verification required
comments.summary: Gross floor area definition and calculation cannot be verified without detailed floor plans showing clear heights, documented area inclusions/exclusions, and reconciliation with stated GFA (83,986 sf).
comments.attn: Verification status: Not-verifiable. Provide detailed floor plans with clear heights (>6 ft) and calculation worksheet documenting inclusions (loading docks) and exclusions (parking, driveways, enclosed loading berths, off-street maneuvering, atria airspace).

details.text: GFA definition correctness cannot be verified. SDT shows total GFA of 83,986 sf but no calculation worksheet, floor plans with clear heights, or notes confirming loading docks inclusion and proper exclusion of parking facilities, driveways, enclosed loading berths, off-street maneuvering areas, and atria airspace per LDC § 25-1-21(47).

runComments.comment: GFA definition correctness cannot be verified. The SDT shows total GFA of 83,986 sq ft but no calculation worksheet, floor plans with clear heights, or notes confirming that loading docks are included and that parking facilities, driveways, enclosed loading berths, off-street maneuvering areas, and atria airspace are properly excluded per LDC § 25-1-21(47). Provide GFA calculation worksheet or detailed floor plans showing clear height measurements and area deductions.

Verification of correct GFA definition application requires detailed floor plans showing: all areas with >6 feet clear height, inclusion of loading docks, exclusion of atria airspace above ground floor, exclusion of parking facilities and driveways, and exclusion of enclosed loading berths and off-street maneuvering areas. Sufficient detail is not available in submitted documents.

GFA calculation cannot be verified as correct without access to detailed building floor plans showing clear heights, loading dock areas, atrium spaces, parking, enclosed loading berths, and off-street maneuvering areas. The total GFA of 83,986 sf is shown in the SDT, but its compliance with the LDC § 25-1-21(47) definition cannot be assessed from the available site plan documents.

comments.headline: Building coverage calculation verification required
comments.summary: Building coverage definition and calculation cannot be verified without detailed roof plans and elevation sheets confirming proper exclusion of ground-level paving, landscaping, open recreational facilities, balconies, and projecting eaves.
comments.attn: Verification status: Not-verifiable. Proposed building coverage of 32,296 sf (34%) is below allowed 47,096 sf (50%), but compliance with definitional exclusions cannot be confirmed without detailed building footprint and elevation documentation.

details.text: Building coverage definition correctness cannot be verified. SDT shows proposed 32,296 sf (34%) and allowed 47,096 sf (50%), but no calculation worksheet, roof plan, or elevation sheets provided to confirm that ground-level paving, landscaping, open recreational facilities, balconies, and projecting eaves are properly excluded per LDC § 25-1-21(14).

runComments.comment: Building coverage definition correctness cannot be verified. The SDT shows proposed building coverage of 32,296 sq ft (34%) and allowed of 47,096 sq ft (50%), but no calculation worksheet, roof plan, or elevation sheets are provided to confirm that ground-level paving, landscaping, open recreational facilities, balconies, and projecting eaves are properly excluded per LDC § 25-1-21(14). Provide detailed roof plan and elevation sheets showing building footprint measurements and exclusions.

Verification that building coverage correctly excludes ground level paving, landscaping, open recreational facilities, incidental projecting eaves, balconies, and similar features requires detailed building elevation and footprint analysis. Sufficient documentation is not available in submitted drawings.

Building coverage calculation cannot be verified without detailed building plans showing footprints, projecting eaves, balconies, and other features to confirm they were properly excluded from the 32,296 sf (34%) proposed building coverage figure per LDC § 25-1-21(14).

comments.headline: Impervious cover calculation worksheet missing
comments.summary: Impervious cover calculation worksheet (Q1/Q2 tables) not provided. SDT shows total IC of 55,502 sf (59%), but cannot verify compliance with prohibition on 2-foot projecting element exemption (eaves, overhangs, balconies, awnings, bay windows).
comments.attn: Critical compliance issue: ECM § 1.8.1(C) and LDC § 25-8-63(C)(13) expressly prohibit the 2-foot projection exemption on site plans. Provide detailed impervious cover calculation worksheet showing all area components and explicitly confirming no projecting element exemptions are claimed.

details.text: Impervious cover calculation worksheet not provided. SDT shows total IC of 55,502 sf (59%) but no Q1/Q2 calculation worksheet available to verify that 2-foot projecting element exemption (eaves, overhangs, balconies, awnings, bay windows) has not been improperly applied. ECM § 1.8.1(C) and LDC § 25-8-63(C)(13) expressly prohibit this exemption on site plans.

runComments.comment: Impervious cover calculation worksheet not provided. The SDT shows total IC of 55,502 sq ft (59%) but no Q1/Q2 impervious cover calculation worksheet is available to verify that the 2-foot projecting element exemption (eaves, overhangs, balconies, awnings, bay windows) has not been improperly applied. ECM § 1.8.1(C) and LDC § 25-8-63(C)(13) expressly prohibit this exemption on site plans. Provide completed impervious cover calculation worksheet showing all area components and confirming no projecting element exemptions are claimed.

Verification that the impervious cover calculation does not improperly apply the 2-foot projecting element exemption requires review of detailed IC worksheets (Q1/Q2 calculation tables). These worksheets showing element-by-element IC accounting are not included in the submitted documents.

Impervious cover calculation worksheets (Q1/Q2 tables or detailed IC calculation showing component breakdown) are not provided in the available documents. Without access to the detailed impervious cover calculation worksheet, compliance with the requirement that the 2-foot projection exemption not be applied to site plans cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Building height measurement methodology not documented
comments.summary: Building height baseline calculation not shown on grading and elevation sheets. LDC § 25-1-21(50) requires height measured from average of highest and lowest adjacent grades, but methodology cannot be verified without clear documentation.
comments.attn: Verification status: Not-verifiable. While stated heights (33'-4.75" to 36'-1") are within 40' limit, compliance measurement methodology cannot be confirmed without explicit grade baseline documentation.

details.text: Building height measurement methodology cannot be verified. LDC § 25-1-21(50) requires height measured from average of highest and lowest adjacent grades. Site plan shows building heights and benchmarks but does not show grade baseline calculation methodology for any building. Grading plan must clearly indicate how height baseline was established.

runComments.comment: Building height measurement methodology cannot be verified. LDC § 25-1-21(50) requires height to be measured from the average of the highest and lowest grades adjacent to each building. The site plan shows building heights and benchmarks but does not show the grade baseline calculation (average of highest and lowest adjacent grades) for any building. The grading plan must clearly indicate how the height baseline was established for each building to confirm compliance.

details.text: Building height calculation baseline cannot be verified. Grading plan and elevation sheets do not explicitly show grade baseline calculation methodology (average of highest and lowest adjacent grades). LDC § 25-1-21(50) requires this methodology. Provide detailed grading and elevation sheets with clearly marked grade reference points.

runComments.comment: Building height calculation baseline cannot be verified. The grading plan and elevation sheets do not explicitly show the grade baseline calculation methodology (average of highest and lowest adjacent grades) used for height measurements. LDC § 25-1-21(50) requires this methodology. Provide detailed grading and elevation sheets showing clearly marked grade reference points and demonstrating that height is measured from the average of the highest and lowest adjacent grades, not from the lowest grade only.

comments.headline: Open space areas not visually delineated on site plan
comments.summary: Required open space areas (4,710 sf provided, documented in SDT) must be visually delineated on site plan drawing for clear identification and area verification.
comments.attn: Verification status: Not-verifiable from submitted documents. Visual delineation of specific open space areas needed to confirm compliance and locate spaces on site.

details.text: Open space areas are required to be delineated on the site plan sheet. Visual delineation of specific open space areas cannot be confirmed from the submitted document analysis without explicit identification on the drawing per Reviewer Convention.

runComments.comment: Open space areas are required to be delineated on the site plan sheet. Visual delineation of specific open space areas cannot be confirmed from the submitted document analysis without explicit identification on the drawing.
